11:   const player = { x: W / 2, y: H * 0.8, r: 8, speed: 3, shield: false, shieldT: 0 };

15:   let score = 0;
16:   let gameOver = false;

18:   // Input handling

22: 
23:   function spawnObstacle() {
24:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
25:     const x = Math.random() * (W - size);
26:     obstacles.push({ x, y: -size, w: size, h: size });
27:   }
28: 
29:   function spawnPowerUp() {
30:     const size = 12;
31:     const x = Math.random() * (W - size);
32:     powerUps.push({ x, y: -size, r: size / 2, collected: false });
33:   }
34: 
35:   function update(dt) {
36:     if (gameOver) return;
37:     // player movement
38:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= player.speed;
39:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += player.speed;
40:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.y -= player.speed;
41:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.y += player.speed;
42:     // keep inside canvas
43:     player.x = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(W - player.r, player.x));
44:     player.y = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(H - player.r, player.y));
45: 
46:     // scroll grid
47:     offsetY += 1.5;
48:     // spawn obstacles/power‑ups
49:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnObstacle();
50:     if (Math.random() < 0.005) spawnPowerUp();
51: 
52:     // move obstacles
53:     obstacles.forEach(o => (o.y += 2));
54:     // move power‑ups
55:     powerUps.forEach(p => (p.y += 2));
56: 
57:     // collision detection
58:     obstacles.forEach((o, i) => {
59:       if (
60:         player.x + player.r > o.x &&
61:         player.x - player.r < o.x + o.w &&
62:         player.y + player.r > o.y &&
63:         player.y - player.r < o.y + o.h
64:       ) {
65:         if (player.shield) {
66:           obstacles.splice(i, 1); // destroy while shielded
67:           score += 10;
68:         } else {
69:           gameOver = true;
70:         }
71:       } else if (o.y > H) {
72:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
73:         score += 5;
74:       }
75:     });
76: 
77:     powerUps.forEach((p, i) => {
78:       const dx = player.x - p.x - p.r;
79:       const dy = player.y - p.y - p.r;
80:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (player.r + p.r) ** 2) {
81:         player.shield = true;
82:         player.shieldT = 600; // frames ~10 s at 60 fps
83:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);
84:         score += 15;
85:       } else if (p.y > H) {
86:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);
87:       }
88:     });
89: 
90:     if (player.shield) {
91:       player.shieldT--;
92:       if (player.shieldT <= 0) player.shield = false;
93:     }
94:     score += dt * 0.01; // distance‑based points
95:   }
96: 
97:   function drawGrid() {
98:     const spacing = 40;
99:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#0ff4';
100:     ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
101:     ctx.beginPath();
102:     for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += spacing) {
103:       ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
104:       ctx.lineTo(x, H);
105:     }
106:     for (let y = -spacing + (offsetY % spacing); y <= H; y += spacing) {
107:       ctx.moveTo(0, y);
108:       ctx.lineTo(W, y);
109:     }
110:     ctx.stroke();
111:   }
112: 
113:   function draw() {
114:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
115:     drawGrid();
116:     // obstacles
117:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0a';
118:     obstacles.forEach(o => ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h));
119:     // power‑ups (glowing circles)
120:     powerUps.forEach(p => {
121:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x + p.r, p.y + p.r, 0, p.x + p.r, p.y + p.r, p.r);
122:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
123:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
124:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
125:       ctx.beginPath();
126:       ctx.arc(p.x + p.r, p.y + p.r, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
127:       ctx.fill();
128:     });
129:     // player (glow)
130:     const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(player.x, player.y, 0, player.x, player.y, player.r * 4);
131:     glow.addColorStop(0, player.shield ? '#ff0' : '#0ff');
132:     glow.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
133:     ctx.fillStyle = glow;
134:     ctx.beginPath();
135:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.r * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
136:     ctx.fill();
137:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
138:     ctx.beginPath();
139:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
140:     ctx.fill();
141:     // score / game over text
142:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
143:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
144:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
145:     if (gameOver) {
146:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
147:       ctx.font = '48px monospace';
148:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
149:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
150:     }
151:   }
152: 
153:   let last = performance.now();
154:   function loop(now) {
155:     const dt = now - last;
156:     last = now;

158:     draw();
159:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);

162: })();
